def digest(data: dict) -> str:
    sha = hashlib.sha256()
    for key, value in sorted(data.items()):
        arr = np.ascontiguousarray(value)
        sha.update(key.encode())
        sha.update(arr.dtype.str.encode())
        sha.update(str(arr.shape).encode())
        sha.update(arr.tobytes())
    return sha.hexdigest()

const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+import numpy as np
+import mujoco
+from scipy.optimize import least_squares
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+import casa_tool
+
+s = casa_tool.Session('/app/instance.npz')
+m, d = s.model, s.data
+site = m.site('gripper0_right_grip_site').id
+adr = np.array([m.joint(f'robot0_joint{i}').qposadr[0] for i in range(1, 8)])
+jids = np.array([m.joint(f'robot0_joint{i}').id for i in range(1, 8)])
+limits = m.jnt_range[jids].copy()
+limits[:, 0] += .02
+limits[:, 1] -= .02
+scratch = mujoco.MjData(m)
+R0 = d.site_xmat[site].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+
+def pos(name):
+    return d.xpos[m.body(name).id].copy()
+
+def hand():
+    return d.site_xpos[site].copy()
+
+def qnow():
+    return d.qpos[adr].copy()
+
+def ik(target, orient=R0):
+    qref = qnow()
+    scratch.qpos[:] = d.qpos
+    def fun(q):
+        scratch.qpos[adr] = q
+        mujoco.mj_forward(m, scratch)
+        p = scratch.site_xpos[site]
+        R = scratch.site_xmat[site].reshape(3, 3)
+        err = Rotation.from_matrix(orient @ R.T).as_rotvec()
+        return np.r_[8*(p-target), 1.3*err, .055*(q-qref)]
+    sol = least_squares(fun, np.clip(qref, limits[:,0], limits[:,1]), bounds=(limits[:,0],limits[:,1]), max_nfev=60, ftol=.002, xtol=.002)
+    return sol.x, np.linalg.norm(fun(sol.x)[:3])/8
+
+def action(q=None, grip=-1, base=(0,0,0), torso=0, mode=-1):
+    a=s.hold_targets()
+    a[:7] = qnow() if q is None else q
+    a[7]=grip; a[8:11]=base; a[11]=torso; a[12]=mode
+    return a
+
+def steps(n, q=None, grip=-1, base=(0,0,0), torso=0, mode=-1):
+    for _ in range(n): s.step(action(q,grip,base,torso,mode))
+
+def goto(target, grip=-1, n=70, tol=.012, orient=R0):
+    q, ikerr=ik(np.asarray(target),orient)
+    print('IK',np.round(target,3),'err',round(ikerr,3),'q',np.round(q,2),flush=True)
+    for i in range(n):
+        s.step(action(q,grip))
+        if i>=10 and np.linalg.norm(hand()-target)<tol: break
+    print('AT',i+1,np.round(hand(),3),'obj1',np.round(pos('obj1_main'),3),'obj2',np.round(pos('obj2_main'),3),flush=True)
+    s.save_trajectory(meta={'stage':str(target)})
+
+def report(label):
+    print(label,'step',len(s.actions),'hand',np.round(hand(),3),'obj1',np.round(pos('obj1_main'),3),'obj2',np.round(pos('obj2_main'),3),'success',s.check(),flush=True)
+    s.save_trajectory(meta={'stage':label})
+
+report('initial') if False else None
+obj=pos('obj1_main')
+goto([obj[0],obj[1],1.12],n=80)
+goto([obj[0],obj[1],obj[2]+.025],n=80)
+steps(30,qnow(),grip=1)
+report('grasp1')
+goto([obj[0],obj[1],1.55],grip=1,n=90)
+report('lift1')
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch))
